input: List exactly three edge cases that a correct is_prime(n) function must handle. Give a short bullet list.
reference: Three valid edge cases: (1) n < 2 (including 0, 1, and negatives) returns False; (2) the small primes 2 and 3 return True; (3) even numbers > 2 are rejected early. (Bool inputs are also an acceptable third item.)

rubric.completeness: Lists three genuinely distinct, correct edge cases (e.g. n < 2; 2 and 3; even numbers > 2).
rubric.correctness: Each listed edge case is factually correct for primality.
